supersedes.rule: Gate strings retained in older bounded module receipts describe their historical frontier only. They must not control the current manager goal or create new normative contracts.

basis: Cross-page source selection and replaced-page refusal were verified against the actual workspace.
The client consumes the shared RUN1000 bound and preserves explicit scope/currentness.
Previously accepted S1-S5, Sources, reader, import and erasure cases remain applicable.

U4-X.scope: Research, Report and Evidence on the canonical HTTP polling/readback baseline; optional ResearchSession projection may remain unavailable/degraded
basis: IntegrationRepairsPreview verifies one minted request identity, an identical body/idempotency key on lost-ack recovery, history-independent reconciliation and the expected 2 catalog reads / 1 mint / 2 same-key POST attempts.
Accepted R1 proves poll/manual status/history/reconnect reads do not allocate another identity or effect.
Accepted R2 proves a fresh required-section failure blocks export and sink/download.
Accepted R3 proves late evidence cannot restore protected state after invalidation.
Retained strict projection-union, expected history-410, completion-not-acceptance, citation separation and no-hidden-reasoning evidence remains applicable.
known_nonblocking_limits: An unacknowledged in-memory intent is not persisted across a full browser reload.
C11 authenticated/full public ResearchSession binding and staging/live transport remain pending; canonical HTTP is the selected review baseline.
No new admission-result endpoint, effect/phase DTO or persistent recovery store is required for this gate.

U5-X.scope: Implemented Studio and truthful Connections internal review baseline
basis: U5-S and U5-C implementation handoffs are complete.
Accepted T1 proves composed capability/connectivity truth without inferring Connected from health or configuration alone.
Accepted T2 proves bounded details/error disclosure without secrets or provider payloads.
Only implemented operations are presented; typed COW/publication/readback and operation-specific pending state remain intact.
known_nonblocking_limits: wiki-proposals.v1 is a bounded list and may report has_more without continuation.
The interface must state that more proposals exist and must not claim complete history.
Pagination/continuation is a separate product/backend follow-up, not a normative U5-X or FINAL-UI blocker.

FINAL-UI.dependency: No external producer contract is blocking the review package. Produce one complete non-production review package, run the final integrated checks and stop for owner review.

withdrawn_blockers.follow_up: Optional future hardening only; do not wait for it and do not infer a new contract from HTTP status.
Keep bounded/incomplete semantics truthful; continuation may be designed separately.

required_final_package_checks: Refresh current main and confirm the owner-web/UI/client source inputs used by the retained gate evidence have not changed or re-run affected checks where they have.
Run TypeScript and ESLint for apps/eliotr-web, packages/ui and packages/owner-api-client.
Run focused Storybook cases including Integration Repairs, Research, Studio and Connections plus one integrated Playwright journey.
Produce the required 1440/1024/768/390, light/dark/high-contrast, RU/EN and useful/loading/empty/degraded/error review matrix without auto-accepting visual diffs.
Report CSP, accessibility, performance, generated Worker/live/staging and release items truthfully as accepted, failed or nonblocking pending according to their actual execution.
nonblocking_pending: Full-reload recovery of an unacknowledged private Research intent
U6 deployment/cutover/release and final implementation merge
next_three_actions: Run the bounded current-source gate/final-package verification; repair only reproduced failures.
Assemble one FINAL-UI review package referencing existing gate receipts instead of expanding proof ledgers.
Present the complete interface for owner review and stop; do not deploy, cut over, delete legacy code or merge the final implementation.
